messages:
anya: heads-up — after yesterday's RBAC rename rollout, acme-corp says users still show admin KMS access even though their SCIM group was removed. KMS key policy still references group principal 'sg-ml-infra-admins'. Can we investigate? /cc @sam :eyes:
sam: on it. can you paste the SCIM group id and an example user?
anya: group id sg-12345, example user uid=u-99872. they were removed at 2160001200 per SCIM events but still decrypting aSSEt logs.
provisioner-bot: SCIM event delivered: group.delete id=sg-12345 tenant=acme-corp ts=2160001200 status=200
infra-bot: quick check: KMS policy snippet for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111122223333:key/abcd-1234:
```json
{
  "Sid": "AllowUseForMlInfra",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::111122223333:group/sg-ml-infra-admins"},
  "Action": ["kms:Decrypt","kms:DescribeKey"]
}
```
matt: that matches my hunch — when we renamed the RBAC group to sg-ml-infra-admins-v2 we created a new externalId in SCIM but never updated the KMS bindings. The old principal stayed in the key policy. SCIM deprovision removed the group on the identity side but the key policies are independent resources.
jordan: root cause summary: our deprovisioner has a 7-day soft-delete rollback window and we rely on a periodic key-prune job to scrub KMS policies. acme-corp had a manual exception on prune so the old principal was never removed.
sam: action plan?
matt: immediate: 1) run audit query to list keys referencing arn:...:group/sg-ml-infra-admins, 2) issue kms:PutKeyPolicy updates to remove that principal, 3) re-run scim-reconcile --tenant acme-corp --force-prune, 4) confirm no active IAM sessions for removed users. I'll take steps 1-2 now.
provisioner-bot: running scim-reconcile --tenant acme-corp (scheduled)
matt: audit query output:
```
key: key/abcd-1234 principals: [arn:aws:iam::111122223333:group/sg-ml-infra-admins]
key: key/efgh-5678 principals: [arn:aws:iam::111122223333:group/sg-ml-infra-admins, arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/ml-runner]
key: key/ijkl-9012 principals: []
```
matt: found 2 keys with the stale group principal. preparing PutKeyPolicy patch to remove it.
security-oncall: I'll open an incident ticket for tracking and customer notification. INC-2026-512 created. Notifying compliance/legal per playbook.
anya: customer notified via support at 10:05 PST; they asked for confirmation when principals are removed.
matt: applied patches to key/abcd-1234 and key/efgh-5678 at 2160001320, verified policy change and tested decrypt failure for an ex-user token.
provisioner-bot: scim-reconcile --tenant acme-corp completed at 2160001330 status=success. prune removed lingering external ids.
jordan: follow-ups: (a) tie KMS key-prune to group lifecycle so policy edits happen atomically on group.delete, (b) remove manual exceptions or require approval path, (c) add alert when a key policy references a group that no longer exists in our SCIM catalog.
security-oncall: adding retention logs and audit entries to the incident. will coordinate postmortem.
sam: good triage. matt/jordan please add remediation PRs and schedule the postmortem. thanks. :thumbsup:
anya: also add a test in the SCIM integration tests to simulate rename+delete and assert key policies are cleaned up.
sam: marking resolved for now pending postmortem and PRs. keep thread updated if anything else shows up. :white_check_mark:
